messages:
sandeep: Heads up — macOS Bazel CI is red on master and a couple PRs. Failing in the PCH precompile/link step after the clang toolchain image roll. Job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/macos-bazel/12345 :eyes: Anyone else seeing this?

ci-bot: Build failed: macos-bazel-compat — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345 (exit code 1)

matt: @sandeep can you paste the failing stderr? Quick search shows similar regressions when precompiled headers or toolchain flags changed.

sandeep: log snippet:
```
ERROR: /workspace/third_party/llvm/BUILD:42:1: Compiling pch failed: clang -isysroot ... -Wl: undefined symbol: _ZNK4llvm...
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1
Target //third_party/llvm:libclang_pch failed to build
```
Seems like a symbol missing during link for PCH archive.

elena: Likely an ABI/visibility mismatch between system clang + libstdc++ and our new toolchain image. We rolled the mac image yesterday. @taylor did the image bump include any new visibility or LTO flags?

taylor: Yes — bumped mac-clang to clang-14 and added -fvisibility-inlines-hidden to default CFLAGS for perf. Could be the culprit. I'm pulling the image diff now.

matt: Can you try a rerun with a CXX flag override? e.g. set BAZEL_CXXOPTS='-fno-visibility-inlines-hidden' for the job and rerun the single failing target. @sandeep can you trigger a rerun?

sandeep: Kicking off a rerun with override now: `bazel test //third_party/llvm:libclang_pch --action_env=BAZEL_CXXOPTS='-fno-visibility-inlines-hidden'`

ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12346

jenkins: Rerun finished: build 12346 — still failing, now with a different error: `error: duplicate symbol _ZN4llvm...`

elena: Duplicates could mean PCH objects are being linked twice or archive layout changed between clang versions. We should bisect the image changes. Steps: reproduce locally with the image, then bisect commits in the image repo.

sandeep: Reproduced locally using the image (docker). Duplicate symbols reproduce. Starting bisect on the image repo. CC @matt for a minimal reproducer.

matt: I'll try to create a minimal repro that builds a small PCH and links it into a tiny target. Also, as a short-term mitigation, can we pin CI to the previous image/tag if master remains red? A fallback policy in CI to pinned images would help.

taylor: I can prepare a rollback tag in the image registry if we confirm root cause. Filing an internal issue now.

sandeep: Filed RED-3211: macOS clang image bump causes PCH link failures (logs + reproducer attached). Starting bisect, will post commits tried.

matt: If bisect points at the visibility flag, we should add a toolchain config that ensures PCH targets get consistent flags (or special-case them). Also add a CI entry to exercise PCH builds across image variants.

elena: Agreed — add a small sanity test to the CI matrix that builds PCHs for each mac image.

sandeep: Update: bisect narrowed it down to commit abc123 -> abd130 where -fvisibility-inlines-hidden was added to the default flags. Reproduces consistently. Assigning to @taylor for follow-up.

taylor: I'll revert the visibility flag in the image and push a hotfix tag, coordinate with infra to redeploy images. ETA ~2h.

matt: :thumbsup: Please add a short postmortem note if we end up rolling back so we can capture the mitigation and add the CI guard.

sandeep: Thanks all — leaving thread open until hotfix rolled. Will post results here.
